* Flash Flood Warning for...
Northeastern Livingston County in central Illinois...
East Central La Salle County in north central Illinois...
Southern Grundy County in northeastern Illinois...

* Until 345 AM CDT.

* At 1147 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated slow moving thunderstorms
with rain rates of 2 to 3 inches per hour. Up to 2.5 inches has
occurred so far just north of Streator. Flash flooding is ongoing
or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Rapid-onset flooding of creeks, streams, drainage ditches,
streets, underpasses, low-lying areas, and other poor
drainage areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Streator, Marseilles, Dwight, Seneca, Gardner, Mazon, South
Streator, Braceville, Grand Ridge, South Wilmington, Ransom,
Kangley, Verona, Campus, Reddick, East Brooklyn and Kinsman.
properties.instruction:
A Flash Flood Warning means rapid-onset flooding is imminent or may
already be occurring. Persons along creeks, drainage ditches, and
other waterways should take immediate precautions to protect life and
property.
properties.area: Grundy, IL; La Salle, IL; Livingston, IL

properties.title: Flood Advisory issued August 9 at 11:23PM CDT until August 10 at 3:30AM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northern Livingston County in central Illinois...
Southern La Salle County in north central Illinois...
Grundy County in northeastern Illinois...
Kendall County in northeastern Illinois...

* WHEN...Until 330 AM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Creeks and streams may rise out of their banks. Roads and
streets may be flooded.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1122 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated slow moving thunderstorms
producing rainfall rates of 1 to 2 inches per hour moving into
the area. Minor flooding may began shortly after the onset of
rainfall.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Yorkville, Streator, Morris, Channahon, Minooka, Coal City,
Dwight, Diamond, Gardner, Odell, Mazon, South Streator, Newark,
Braceville, Cornell, South Wilmington and Millington.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
A Flood Advisory means minor flooding along waterways and other poor
drainage areas is imminent or may already be occurring. Persons in
the advisory area should use caution and avoid flood waters.
properties.area: Grundy, IL; Kendall, IL; La Salle, IL; Livingston, IL
